observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nagtatanong nang bukas at walang paratang; gumagamit ng isang tiyak na follow-up; ibinubuod ang sagot at humihingi ng pagwawasto.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Uses a neutral open question, one focused follow-up and a summary that invites correction.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Naglalagay ng motibo sa tanong o nagtatala ng kahulugang hindi kinumpirma.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Embeds a motive in the question or records an interpretation that was not checked.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nagtatanong nang bukas at walang paratang; gumagamit ng isang tiyak na follow-up; ibinubuod ang sagot at humihingi ng pagwawasto. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Uses a neutral open question, one focused follow-up and a summary that invites correction. Completes this without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Maayos ang bukas na tanong ngunit malabo pa ang follow-up; ipaulit gamit ang “Ano ang ibig mong sabihin sa…?”
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Uses an open question but the follow-up remains unclear; repeat using “What do you mean by…?”
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Naglalagay ng motibo sa tanong o nagtatala ng kahulugang hindi kinumpirma.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Embeds a motive in the question or records an interpretation that was not checked.
